items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: The transcript mentions Sonny Payne only in the context of his father Chris Columbus having an orchestra; the interviewee does not describe a personal or professional relationship with Sonny Payne.

ctx.x: They had their own house band. Chris Columbus, who is the father of Sonny Payne, he had the orchestra there at that time.
And here, what other bands did you work with.
